title: clitoria flagellaris
intro: Clitoria flagellaris, commonly known as the Butterfly Pea or Asian Pigeonwings, is a flowering plant native to tropical regions of Asia. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and improving cognitive function due to its antioxidant properties. Therapeutically, Clitoria flagellaris is believed to have anti-anxiety, anti-depressant, and anti-inflammatory actions, attributed to its ability to modulate neurotransmitters and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents present in Clitoria flagellaris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential applications in traditional medicine.
